current_support.batch_scope: G06a/b/c canonical goals have bounded independent acceptance; see ../maintenance/reviews/20261116_g06c_attempt001_acceptance.md and the linked 6a/6b reviews. Three providers × Pendulum/PickCube native CUDA batch, source-bound canonical actions, device Task/state, same-step terminal observations/images, independent sensor/window paths and device Recorder have bounded evidence. G06c B3 partial reset and staggered truncation cover all six cells; whole-batch same-Env switching is limited to Isaac ↔ MJWarp with fixed shared Rasterizer on both tasks. Geometry from other rows can enter a camera view; cross-row visual isolation is not promised. GeoPhys PickCube acceptance requires explicit discrete mode and contact/coupled 32 iterations under the tested configuration; default-budget penetration and continuous mesh/constraint limitations are not resolved by that acceptance. GeoPhys cross-provider switching is not admitted. R3 is separate; G07 and version closeout remain pending. GeoPhys main merge/AOT remain maintainer-deferred, not PASS.
